title: Marshal Histent / Grinbik the Fertile rescue
summary: Defeat Marshal Histent and subdue Grinbik to free him from control.
overview: Defeat Marshal Histent and subdue Grinbik to free him from control.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Handle the marshal and his supporting enemies without losing control of Grinbik.
Lower Grinbik to 10% and allow the surrender check to complete.
The eligible ranger should hail the freed Grinbik to finish the rescue.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
